description: This file is an include file for configuring the build of the 'libgfortran' library, part of a cross-compilation setup in an OE/BitBake build environment. It contains configuration functions for building, installing, and packaging, as well as dependencies and licensing information related to the 'libgfortran' package.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures build environments for 'libbacktrace' and 'libgfortran' targeted builds by setting up directories and running configuration scripts.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'libbacktrace' and 'libgfortran' targets using make within their respective directories.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled 'libgfortran' into the destination directory and cleans up empty directories.
